source: 外研社版必修第二册 Unit 5 同主题完形(独自首旅/沿河骑行/异城迷路/爱坐火车/星空露营/海外寄宿)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词;每空四选项同词性、答案唯一;六篇与阅读、听力不复用。

passages.title: My First Trip Alone
passages.text: Last summer I went on my first trip (1)____, without my parents. I had saved enough money and made a careful (2)____ so that I would not spend too much. At the airport I had to (5)____ some money into the local currency. When I arrived, a kind driver took me to my (6)____ along a busy road. The city was bigger than I had (7)____, and at first I felt a little lost. But I bought a paper (8)____ and marked my hotel on it. Slowly I learned to find my (9)____ around the streets. By the end of the week I felt much more (10)____, and I could not wait to plan my next journey.

passages.title: Lost in a New City
passages.text: On my second day in the city, I decided to (1)____ the old town on my own. Everything looked new and (2)____, and soon I had no idea where I was. I took out my phone to check the map, but there was no (3)____, so it was useless. For a moment I felt a little (4)____, standing alone among strangers. She did not speak much English, but she drew a simple (7)____ on a piece of paper. Following her arrow, I turned left at the church and walked straight (8)____. Ten minutes later I could see the (9)____ sign of my hotel ahead. I felt so (10)____ that I had not given up. Getting lost had become part of the adventure.

passages.title: Why I Love Train Travel
passages.text: Of all the ways to travel, I love going by (1)____ best of all. Unlike a plane, a train lets you watch the (2)____ change slowly outside your window. You can read a book, enjoy a hot drink, or simply (5)____ out of the window for hours. Trains are also kinder to the (6)____ than cars or planes, because they use less fuel for each traveller. Best of all, the (7)____ itself becomes part of the holiday, not just a boring wait. Last year I took a slow train across the (8)____, and I still remember every view. When the sun was (9)____ behind the hills, the whole sky turned gold. For me, a train window is the best (10)____ in the world.

passages.title: A Homestay Abroad
